name: 83815 · Coeur D Alene, ID
findings: ZIP 83815 (Coeur D Alene) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83815 (Coeur D Alene) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83815 (Coeur D Alene) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
